# NinjaOne

> Public documentation index for the NinjaOne platform (formerly NinjaRMM): the Public API v2 reference and OpenAPI specs, OAuth 2.0, device filters, webhooks, custom fields, and help center articles for the features this MCP server's tools reach. Compiled for agents building or using ninja-one-mcp. Every link was checked on 2026-11-23. Unverified links are left out. NinjaOne instances are regional: replace `app.ninjarmm.com` with `us2`, `eu`, `ca` or `oc` as needed. The API base is `https://{host}/v2/` and OAuth is at `https://{host}/ws/oauth/token`.

Key facts:

- Regions: `app.ninjarmm.com` (US), `us2.ninjarmm.com` (US2), `eu.ninjarmm.com` (EU), `ca.ninjarmm.com` (Canada), `oc.ninjarmm.com` (Oceania). Every API client exists in exactly one of them.
- Auth: OAuth 2.0. This server uses `client_credentials` with a form-encoded POST to `/ws/oauth/token`.
  - Scopes are `monitoring` (read), `management` (write) and `control` (remote actions and scripts).
  - Access tokens last 3600 seconds in the documented example.
- Paging: `pageSize` plus `after` (the last id) on list endpoints. `cursor` (a cursor name) on `/v2/queries/*`. `pageInfo.nextCursor` with `after` on ITAM.
- Device filter: the `df` query parameter (see Device Filters below).
- Rate limits: no public page gives numbers. The spec documents 429 on some endpoints. Retry with backoff and honor `Retry-After`.

## API reference

- [Public API reference, beta (US)](https://app.ninjarmm.com/apidocs-beta/): The current reference UI with auth guides and articles. Copies exist on us2, eu, ca and oc.
- [Public API docs, Swagger UI (US)](https://app.ninjarmm.com/apidocs/): The original Swagger UI, with Authorization and Core Resources sections.
- [Public API reference, beta (EU)](https://eu.ninjarmm.com/apidocs-beta/): EU copy of the reference.
- [Public API reference, beta (US2)](https://us2.ninjarmm.com/apidocs-beta/): US2 copy.
- [Public API reference, beta (CA)](https://ca.ninjarmm.com/apidocs-beta/): Canada copy.
- [Public API reference, beta (OC)](https://oc.ninjarmm.com/apidocs-beta/): Oceania copy.

## OpenAPI specs

- [NinjaRMM-API-v2.yaml (US)](https://app.ninjarmm.com/apidocs-beta/NinjaRMM-API-v2.yaml): OpenAPI 3.0.1, "NinjaOne Public API 2.0" 2.0.9-draft, 315 operations. This is the source of `spec/ninjaone-public-api-v2.yaml` in this repo.
- [NinjaRMM-API-v2.yaml (EU)](https://eu.ninjarmm.com/apidocs-beta/NinjaRMM-API-v2.yaml): EU variant with the same 315 operations. ca and oc serve the same file.
- [NinjaRMM-API-v2.json (US)](https://app.ninjarmm.com/apidocs/NinjaRMM-API-v2.json): The JSON spec behind the original Swagger UI.
- [authorization.json](https://app.ninjarmm.com/apidocs/authorization.json): OpenAPI for `/ws/oauth/authorize` and `/ws/oauth/token`.

## Authorization

- [OAuth 2.0 Authorization Framework overview](https://app.ninjarmm.com/apidocs-beta/articles/authorization/overview.md): Grant types, endpoints, and which flow to use.
- [Client Credentials Flow](https://app.ninjarmm.com/apidocs-beta/articles/authorization/flows/client-credentials-flow.md): Machine-to-machine token request and an example response. This is the flow this server uses.
- [Register Machine-to-Machine Applications](https://app.ninjarmm.com/apidocs-beta/articles/authorization/create-applications/machine-to-machine-apps.md): Creating the API Services app this server needs.
- [API OAuth Token Configuration](https://www.ninjaone.com/docs/application-programming-interface-api/oauth-token-configuration/): Registering a client app, grant types, redirect URLs, and the monitoring, management and control scopes.
- [Refresh Tokens](https://app.ninjarmm.com/apidocs-beta/articles/authorization/refresh-tokens.md): The `offline_access` scope and `grant_type=refresh_token`.
- [Authorization Code Flow](https://app.ninjarmm.com/apidocs-beta/articles/authorization/flows/authorization-code-flow.md): The server-side web app flow.
- [Authorization Code Flow with PKCE](https://app.ninjarmm.com/apidocs-beta/articles/authorization/flows/authorization-code-flow-with-proof-key-for-code-exchange-pkce.md): For native apps and SPAs.
- [Public API 2.0 Authorization](https://www.ninjaone.com/docs/application-programming-interface-api/public-api-2-0-authorization/): Using a token or session key in the docs UI.

## API guides

- [Device Filters](https://app.ninjarmm.com/apidocs-beta/articles/devices/device-filters.md): Syntax for the `df` parameter, used by list and report tools.
- [Webhooks Overview](https://app.ninjarmm.com/apidocs-beta/articles/webhooks/overview.md): Configuring the API webhook, the source hostnames per region, and the payload schema.
- [Custom Fields Values](https://app.ninjarmm.com/apidocs-beta/articles/customFields/customFieldsValues/custom-fields-values.md): Value formats for each custom field type when reading or writing.
- [NinjaOne Documentation: Public API](https://www.ninjaone.com/docs/application-programming-interface-api/public-api-operations/): Where the docs are, testing requests, and finding ids.
- [Filter NinjaOne Tickets with the Public API](https://www.ninjaone.com/docs/application-programming-interface-api/ticket-filtering-api/): Filter syntax for the ticket board endpoints.
- [Use API and CLI with Device Tags](https://www.ninjaone.com/docs/administration/device-and-system-tags/device-tagging-api-cli/): Tag endpoints.
- [Reading from or Writing to Documentation: Automation, CLI, and API](https://www.ninjaone.com/docs/ninjaone-documentation/documentation-automation-cli-api-integration/): IT documentation through the API.
- [ITAM: Use API Scripts to Access Core Asset Fields](https://www.ninjaone.com/docs/information-technology-asset-management-itam/access-core-asset-fields-api-scripts/): ITAM core fields.
- [Application Programming Interface (API) articles](https://www.ninjaone.com/docs/application-programming-interface-api/): Index of all API help articles.
- [Integration and Feature Availability by Instance](https://www.ninjaone.com/docs/integrations/integration-feature-availability-by-instance/): Which features each regional instance has.
- [NinjaOne API License Agreement](https://www.ninjaone.com/api-license-agreement/): The API terms of use.

## Official MCP server

- [Katana AI: Getting Started with the Model Context Protocol](https://www.ninjaone.com/docs/ticketing/katana-ai-getting-started-with-the-model-context-protocol/): NinjaOne's own hosted MCP server at `https://{instance}/api/v2/mcp/`. It currently supports the monitoring scope only. ninja-one-mcp is an independent project and is not affiliated with it.
